verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Pipecat itself extracting structured post-call data (outcomes, entities, dispositions) or delivering it via an API or registrable outbound webhook. What the pack does show are developer building blocks: turn events for collecting transcripts, Flows functions that can call external APIs, and a carrier-side inbound telephony webhook. A developer could build extraction from these, but they are not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call
